description: Yemen - Electricity Transmission Network is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy access, Power system and utilities", published or maintained by Haroun Beltaifa (World Bank Group). Main nodes and major lines of the electricity transmission network of Yemen. The properties for nodes are "name" and "node type" (city, town, plant, dam...). The properties for lines are the "transmission power" in kV (e.g. Coverage: Yemen. It has 1 file in GeoJSON. The portal files it under Energy access, Power system and utilities, Transmission and distribution. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
